column1: # done_enemies (batch 2, _todo rows 101-200) — srcline <TAB> english. Realm badges skipped.

column2: A crazed Earth-Tier hunter. He got stronger — but at what cost?
Fusing ice and flame in one, it gained the power of Sync. At least it won't steal Agility…
Ta-da, an attack checkpoint! The Explorer's Wraith bug will never happen again~
As higher-grade Furballs, they need Rank 3 to form a bud. But the Crypt Metal it stole is nice!
Finally — an edible Wildbeast appears in the Crypt! Sky Sword is nothing against its feeble 3400 attack.
How come it has no Time-Seal? Did the Rank-3 skeleton up front snatch it?
Of all things to study, it studied Restraint… guess why it's stuck at Basic?
~True·God·Descends~ Stats and mechanics together, the Ethereal has chased you all the way into the RPG!
It sure looks like an aura monster… yet it isn't, huh.
Seemingly a creation left by the Crypt's master, but the frenzied aura has left it knowing only slaughter.
Innate Technique · 3-Hit Combo! But channeling the Technique seems to drain its life force…
Only two of its legs are strong, so it can only do a 2-hit combo. The Gel it drops is made of spider silk.
A giant bird flitting endlessly around the Crypt because its pathfinding is broken.
He's too poor to afford recovery items. Luckily, an ancestral Technique lets him drain enemies' power as life force.
Super huge! Super tasty! Neko's drooling to tears!
Red cap~ white stalk~ eat it and we all lie flat together~ wait, it's not even red…
Seemingly the super-evolved form of the Fluorescent Moth. It's so hot it's glowing red!
It absorbed the essence of many Wildbeasts and adventurers… and all its stats conflicted, wiping out its skills.
Fortified and thick-blooded. Looks strong… but Fortify fears Sister!
A mushroom-type Wildbeast fond of enfeeble tricks. The effect's decent!
A pale-green moth of the Wildbeast Forest. Contrary to popular belief, green doesn't mean poisonous.
A Basic Magician that broke free of Restraint's shackles and grew more than twice as strong.
Its arrow damage is underwhelming, but its melee is way too strong…
A Wildbeast seemingly far stronger than the others nearby. Its ramming horn lets it deal two hits!
Still steaming! The Crypt Breeder is STILL steaming! (Note: Basic Attack Multiplier deals extra damage to Fortified enemies.)
Unexpectedly, people from other fiefs all come to train in the Wildbeast Forest. What a popular spot.
A Cavern Bird that evolved again after crawling out of the Crypt. Its pathfinding's been fixed now!
An Earth Dragon Cub of higher bloodline purity. Compared to it, the one in Yangang City is a big snake at best!
The Budding Green Furball's evolution path stops at Earth-Tier Rank 3. So it resolutely decided to grow arms and legs…
A spider that recovers stamina mid-battle. With the turn-doubling limit removed, it's even tougher.
Bloodfall Continent Wildbeasts aren't like Earth's monsters; they usually don't gain full intelligence until Sky-Tier. This one… maybe it mutated?
Qianye-Yeqian-Qianye… the homophone pun's been power-crept out of the meta!
A demon-puppet that fled the Crypt in the same batch as the Cavern Bird and Basic Magician. Sadly, it still clings to Restraint.
A Furball that chose to study magic against the Rank-4 bottleneck. But its magic is way too weak!
Are the Bloodkill Hall remnants really all wiped out…? Why does this steward look like a Wildbeast?
A goblin you could call thick-skinned and tough. It'd be better if it weren't so easy to hit.
At least it has no thorns damage. It looks prickly just to look at.
The normal play is to just pickaxe around it… too bad pickaxes can't break forest terrain in an RPG.
The unrelenting Baifang left many Hundred-Clans scouts by the riverbank. But they've no heart for fighting — why risk your life over 3000X a month?
Setting everything else aside, looking like that, who'd dare board your boat!
In one timeline, it burrowed into the Crypt's shallow layer and conspired with the Tiny-Flower Spirit Array to make Neko utterly miserable. Luckily, here it just sits obediently by the river.
Spirit-gathering~ soul-gathering~ entwining~ reviving. The Bloodfall Continent's energy is so abundant even bones can become powerhouses!
Busking around pays way more than weeding in the Crypt! With Sky Sword, who wants a junk skill like Slash Formation?
An aura-type Furball that seems to have taken a wrong turn. Its buff is only half the Spirit-Vine Furball's; its one trait is hiding underwater, hard to catch.
Compared to the Earth Dragon Cub, it gained the ability to breathe fire in the air. Before Sky-Tier, flight is the ultimate symbol of strength!
Why is there an octopus on land… once it climbs up it's clumsy, can't combo, and isn't fast. Better just go back to the river.
The old sailors by the river all have a trump card. Zhuge repeating crossbow, come forth… though it's only three shots.
Oh no! It's a Great Bewitch! Quick, eat a Water-Heart Shield!… oh, not that one. A mere 10000 Domain~
How evil — a Fortified enemy actually having base defense… because of it, the 0.1% Magic Attack was removed!
A cloud-monster grinning with ill intent. Its attack power is shocking.
Seemingly the boss of those earlier sailors. He even opened a shop nearby… go take a look~
Doesn't look as strong as the last few… wait? How much Enfeeble?
From long habit of bullying the weak, it's grown far weaker than same-tier Wildbeasts, monsters, or humans. Still, bullying a Rank-5 sailor is doable.
A monster that seems to reverse-use self-destruct magic. If the health exchange ratio even exceeds 4:1, the single drop of blood left after self-destruct is a fine way to scavenge loot.
The boats he steals are far pricier than the ones bandits rob. Through long effort, he's trained a nimble body!
Why is the Na Family Secret Realm open to other sects…? Maybe the Na Family's youth aren't enough to explore so vast a realm?
Even rogue cultivators showed up! Seems the realm's opening is a twice-yearly event…
The skeleton's next evolution stage after reviving. Rather than the brute dual-wield approach, it chose to equip a shield and armor.
A device within the realm that boosts Wildbeast and monster power. It has no attack, but can only be shattered once your power passes a certain threshold. (Or Magic Attack.)
A red-eyed monster with the power of Reversal. A bit fragile in health, but high defense makes up for it.
Damn, a rival! How come everyone else gets in right at the top edge of the level range…
Seemingly a hybrid of the Venomlord Scorpion and Earth Dragon. That night, they weren't drunk — but waiting for the twice-yearly realm to reopen was just too unbearable.
A powerful magic Wildbeast. Its endless life force paired with the Scattered Bloom insight makes it exceptionally tough.
185k attack, 20-hit combo, 40% aura… the depths of the realm are destined to be fraught with difficulty.
A pitiful enemy exiled to 2-2 for suffering from low defense. Remember to go back and grab the fly— the Superior Green Gem!
The guardian of the Barrier Lake. Yet, just as the Ancestor feared, the explorers have already swarmed in.
A "Spirit" naturally bred in the Barrier Lake. After years of accumulating energy it's reached Earth-Tier Rank 7.
A Hedgehog Sprite made crystal-clear from feeding on "Spirits." It's had a hard trek all the way from the Wildbeast Forest.
Actually the previous one was the strongest of this clan. It exiled all the others into the Barrier Lake…
An elf honor-guard that gained the power of [9]. Deal with it fast or there'll be big trouble.
Why are the Horned Tribe and Hundred-Clans guards drunk too… people can't, or at least shouldn't!
The form of a realm "Spirit" possessing a rock. A touch harder than a Reef Spirit.
A blademan who does tricks with an ordinary weapon like it's a psychokinetic one; known in the martial world as the 14th reserve member of the 13 Axes.
You really can't blame it for learning Restraint. When everyone nearby is a glass-cannon, it's just too profitable…
A Furball that switched evolution paths midway. This road ends at Sky-Tier Rank 2, but the realm's energy is already stretched thin.
A slime mutant that lacks base stats but can deal tons of damage via Ethereal (not THAT many tons).
Here comes the Time-Seal… so squishy! Basic Attack Multiplier really is a wonderful thing.
A super mega tank. Even Restraint can't rein in its outrageous survivability.
A mage in the realm. Not only did it skip Restraint, it learned Combo — right on the money…
So strong just from a change of clothes! Were the old green outfit and black-red shield really that useless…
Though it looks like a poison-type Wildbeast, counterintuitively it can heal itself.
A Wildbeast with extremely high defense. So far no octopus seems to have an 8-hit combo… maybe strengthening all eight limbs at once takes too much energy.
An unremarkable Ruins explorer. The competition here has escalated to where only the late Earth-Tier may enter.
A mushroom seemingly from Shenghuang City. It inherited mushrooms' usual poison magic and is somehow also very greedy?
Hey, a fellow townsman~ Yangang City folk have no particular weakness. Unlike Shenghuang City residents who can't walk past money, or Lanling City residents obsessed with gems.
Its bones are refined to [Blue Jade] grade. Pick it up and use it straight as Coiled Crystal!
It has decent mechanics, but starved for days, its health is nearly bottomed out. Even Otherworld Gate can't help.
Tear-jerker breakdown: summons don't drop gems or items, only XP.
Ugh, Summon. Why does a skill like this even exist…
